evals.name: trading-research-three-jobs
evals.prompt: /plugin-dev:design-plugin --new trading-agents a plugin for stock research agents
evals.expected_output: Charts page: per-filing readers fanned out and checked, a per-ticker status every job reads, a peer/sector comparison, thin deep-dive/screen/review workflows; a system chart showing where they meet
expectations: The charts page is an .html file in outputs/ with one <pre class="mermaid"> chart per workflow the user named, plus one system chart
Chat message does not dump raw mermaid code (no ```mermaid fence in the final chat message)
Every workflow chart has a caption naming its Unit, what it is Strengthened by, and where its Inputs come from
Agents are not one-per-job: at least one agent or agent-written file is used by two or more of the typed jobs
Fan-out: at least one agent is designed to run as parallel instances, one per unit of source material
The unit is strengthened: an evaluator or reviewer, in a separate agent from the producer, checks unit outputs against their source, or the page states why the unit needs none
Every input a unit needs besides its source (which units to run on, what to look for) is attributed on the page to the user, a named file, or another loop
The system chart shows at least one file that one loop writes and a different loop or workflow reads
Comparison: a component judges the entity against a named baseline (sector/industry peers, the field, the cohort), and it is part of the core design, not marked as a suggestion
Charts and components table agree: every agent and typed command in the table appears in at least one chart, and every chart node is in the table
Core stands without suggestions: no asked/composed component reads a suggested component's file

Page renders standalone: declares <meta charset="utf-8">, loads mermaid from cdnjs, initializes it theme-aware (dark/default) with flowchart useMaxWidth false, charts inside an overflow-x:auto container
Every chart is legible at page width: each mermaid source has at most ~25 nodes and ~35 edges
Nothing is written in the repo before approval: the transcript shows no branch or worktree created, no new-plugin run, and no file written outside outputs/
evals.added_in: design-plugin split (moved from plan-phases evals 1-3, charts gate in place of the proposal)

evals.name: research-scientist-two-loops
evals.prompt: /plugin-dev:design-plugin --new idea-lab a research scientist plugin that comes up with new research ideas by reading papers
evals.expected_output: Two connected loops: a cheap survey of the whole library writes an index the orchestrator reads to choose papers and a question for each; a per-paper claim extractor, fanned out and conditioned on that question, writes claims with evidence that an evaluator checks; both jobs share the extractor and the index
expectations: The unit of work is one paper: an agent reads one paper and writes its claims, each paired with the evidence behind it (an experiment, table, figure or section), and runs as parallel instances, one per paper
The claim extraction is conditioned on a question: the per-paper extractor takes a question or focus as an input, and its output records which question it answered
A component (a workflow skill or orchestrating agent) chooses which papers to extract from and what question to ask each, and the page names the file it chooses from
A separate, cheaper pass covers the whole library (every paper, lightly: summary, topics or abstract-level index) and is distinct from the claim extraction
The two loops meet at a named file: the survey pass writes it, and the component that chooses papers and questions reads it
The survey index is built once and refreshed only for new or changed papers, not re-run from scratch on every job
An evaluator in a separate agent from the extractor checks extracted claims against the source paper (core or suggested)
Both typed jobs (idea generation and question answering) use the same claim extractor and the same survey index rather than each having its own reader
Cost tiers are stated: the survey covers all ~300 papers at low depth, while deep claim extraction covers only a selected subset per run
Ideas are grounded: the idea-generation workflow's output cites the extracted claims and evidence it rests on
The page has one mermaid chart per workflow plus a system chart showing both loops and the file between them
Nothing is written in the repo before approval: the transcript shows no branch or worktree created, no new-plugin run, and no file written outside outputs/

evals.name: trading-through-writeup
evals.prompt: /plugin-dev:design-plugin --new trading-agents a plugin for stock research agents
evals.expected_output: After both approvals, outputs/trading-agents/site/notes/0.1-design.md holds the full writeup in the template's order, complete enough for a planner that saw no discussion; the chat points to plan-phases in a new chat
expectations: outputs/trading-agents/site/notes/0.1-design.md exists

It has these ## headings, in this order: The idea, Workflows, How they fit together, Components, Outputs, Cost, Decisions taken, Platform facts, Build order, Non-goals (What must not break absent or deleted, since the mode is new)
Under Workflows, every workflow has its own ### heading, a mermaid chart, a Unit line, a Strengthened by line, and an Input | Supplied by table
How they fit together has a mermaid system chart and a table with the columns File, Written by, Read by, Fields read, Stale when, with at least one file read by two workflows
Outputs states, for every file a reader depends on, what it cites, what it must never claim, and when it goes stale
Cost gives, for every workflow, what a cold run reads and what a warm run reads, and the horizon assumed
Decisions taken is a table with an Origin column, and the accepted suggestions appear in it or in Components with origin suggested
Platform facts marks each fact verified or assumed
Build order names the smallest end-to-end slice and does not list numbered phases or phase notes
The writeup was shown and approved before being written to its final path: the transcript shows a second approval question after the charts approval
No phase notes, progress ledger or eval sets were written: outputs/ contains no *-00-overview.md, *-progress.md or evals/sets/*.json
outputs/chat.md tells the user to run /plugin-dev:plan-phases 0.1 in a new chat, and says why it is a new chat
